tasks.title: Foundation: bootstrap Bun + Lesto monorepo
tasks.description: Establish root workspaces, Oxlint/Oxfmt/TypeScript gates, one Lesto web origin, domain package, and an iOS workspace placeholder. Done when a clean checkout installs and `bun run gate` passes.

tasks.title: Domain: model people, households, participants, teams, and roles
tasks.description: Create framework-independent schemas and policies separating Person, Account, Household, Participant, GuardianRelationship, Team, Season, Membership, and Role. Children must not require accounts; multiple guardians and multi-team households must work. Include policy and audit-event tests.

tasks.title: Foundation: create native SwiftUI iOS application
tasks.description: Create the Snackday Xcode project under apps/ios with app, domain, design-system, and test targets. Add root xcodebuild scripts. Support current iOS, Swift concurrency, Swift Testing, previews, and accessibility defaults.

tasks.title: Web: build marketing and signed-in application shells
tasks.description: Use one Lesto origin: public marketing routes and an authenticated /app shell. Establish responsive navigation, accessible components, tokens, error boundaries, empty/loading states, and metadata. Done when both shells build and render locally.

tasks.title: Identity: adult authentication, invitations, and authorization
tasks.description: Integrate Lesto identity/authz for Sign in with Apple and email invitations. Invitations resolve to intended team/participant relationships, can be resent/revoked, do not duplicate identities, and every operation is authorized server-side.

tasks.title: Teams: create a team, season, roles, and setup checklist
tasks.description: Managers enter team name, sport, age group, dates, timezone, and optional organization; receive manager access and a setup checklist. Support multiple managers/coaches, custom volunteer roles, edits, archiving, and audited role changes.

tasks.title: Roster: add or import participants with guardians in one flow
tasks.description: Support minimal participant creation, CSV preview/validation, duplicate detection, and adding multiple guardians during roster entry. No child email is required. Show invitation status and privacy-aware directory/export.

tasks.title: Events: practices, games, attendance, and private iCalendar feeds
tasks.description: Create recurring events with timezone, location, notes, cancellation, and attendance per child. Provide revocable private iCalendar feeds compatible with Apple and Google Calendar plus individual ICS export.

tasks.title: Duties: unlimited volunteer slots, snack rotation, and swaps
tasks.description: Add custom duties to events with instructions and capacity. Guardians can claim, release, or request swaps; managers can assign. Handle concurrent claims safely and generate an editable snack rotation across events.

tasks.title: Notifications: announcements, reminders, and delivery preferences
tasks.description: Implement canonical in-app messages and idempotent email delivery with Lesto queue/mail. Support team/role/event/duty audiences, recipient preview, reminder timezones, preferences, and observable delivery failures. Keep SMS feature-flagged.

tasks.title: Compliance: document requests, signatures, and audit exports
tasks.description: Store private versioned documents; capture acknowledgement/signature, adult identity, time, version, and audit metadata. Show completion status and export records. Obtain legal review for the intended compliance claims.

tasks.title: Photos: private team albums with consent and moderation
tasks.description: Support resilient multi-photo upload, metadata stripping, derivatives, browsing, deletion, reporting, private authorization, and documented retention. Surface photo-consent status before publishing/tagging workflows.

tasks.title: Launch: privacy, child safety, accessibility, and retention review
tasks.description: Document and validate COPPA posture, parental consent, minimization, export/deletion, photo retention, invite security, abuse handling, staff access, WCAG 2.2 AA, Dynamic Type, VoiceOver, and localization readiness. Blocks production launch.

tasks.title: Launch: automate the critical team coordination journey
tasks.description: Automate create team → import participant → connect guardian → publish event → subscribe calendar → claim snack duty → receive reminder → sign document → upload/view photo across web/API, with focused iOS UI coverage.
